meaning: Conditional R04 instructions and corrected comparison helper are acceptable in the bounded source/structural scope. This is not formal overall quality PASS, migration approval, user effectiveness, improvement, or equivalence evidence.

source_review.scope: Bounded original sections, historical NISO version with current status unverified, related W3C sources and SharePoint-specific operations distinguished.

limitations: Same-model independent thread, not objective human assessment.
One paired synthetic task and one trial per arm; zero score difference supports neither general improvement nor complete equivalence.
Anonymous assignment mapping was not opened, but method names may reveal assignment.
No browser rendering, actual UI operation, product migration, runtime authorization, index update, or participant outcome was measured.

Initial fixture coverage was authored after reading task/candidate/research summaries; researcher summaries contained proposed test descriptions. Parent executable tests, 96-task data, rubric/oracle, and generated proposals were not read before initial fixture execution.
Output-collision discovery belongs to the parent hypothesis; this review supplied independent reproduction and correction verification.
Initial experiment helper and corrected final helper remain distinct and separately hashed.
